subject.title: feat: apply messages.responsePrefix to message tool outbound sends

question: Should `message(action=send)` resolve `{provider}`, `{model}`, `{modelFull}`, and `{thinkingLevel}` from the current agent attempt, or should message-tool sends officially support only static and identity response prefixes?
rationale: Current main deliberately avoids leaking raw `{model}` tokens, but docs and real operator workflows rely on model attribution; choosing how much live run context the outbound tool may consume is a product/runtime contract decision.

options.title: Resolve current-run model context
options.body: Propagate the selected provider/model/thinking context into visible message-tool sends, with tests proving static, identity, dynamic, idempotent, and no-context fallback behavior.

options.title: Document static/identity-only sends
options.body: Keep the current skip-unresolved behavior and document that model-attribution prefixes are only guaranteed on direct reply paths unless a later attribution surface is approved.

options.title: Fold into broader attribution design
options.body: Track this under the broader model-attribution/fallback visibility work so message prefixes, footers, and fallback notices share one contract.

recommendation.title: Resolve current-run model context
recommendation.body: Propagate the selected provider/model/thinking context into visible message-tool sends, with tests proving static, identity, dynamic, idempotent, and no-context fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice crosses outbound tool delivery and reply-prefix runtime context, and recent history shows repeated ownership of those core seams.
